notes.name: case_narrative
notes.text: M aged 49 yrs adm c h/o fever, disorientation & drowsiness for last 2 days. Focal neurological findings identified on physical examination & provisional Dx of meningitis made. diagnostic lumber puncture performed for CSF examination. Staphylococcus aureus organism isolated from CSF & provisional Dx confirmed as Staphylococcus aureus meningitis. Despite IV antibiotic administration his condition worsened & on 3rd of admission blood cultures also positive for Staphylococcus aureus & pt expired on 4th day of admission due to septic shock. He Dx case of type II DM for last 10 yrs & has had renal transplant 6 yrs back.
